scene.rebuild: dataset_codebase Forest scene with the Easy v2 props layout of easy_v2_037 (envs.boot('Forest', ..., mission_id='easy_v2_037'))

start.state: in the air, hovering, armed, PX4 Position mode
start.note: the runner flies the take-off and the turn to this heading by itself and hands control to the agent here

mount.roll/pitch: stabilised gimbal; pitch commanded per mission stage, positive = looking down

rgb.mount: 0.12 m forward of and 0.07 m below the airframe centre, yaw locked to the airframe, stabilised (no roll)

observation.pose: drone position (ENU metres) and heading every frame, as in telemetry.json pose

action.stop: ends the episode; the drone holds its position (the agent says: I am done)
action.collision: the simulator ends the episode at the first prohibited contact (any contact of the drone with anything; this episode has no landing), right after that 240 Hz physics step
action.autopilot: PX4 v1.14.3 SITL, Position mode, sticks over MAVLink MANUAL_CONTROL

coordinate_frame: ENU metres (x east, y north, z up); yaw 0 = +x, counter-clockwise positive; camera pitch positive = down
